# InTheWake: what it can do, and how it got here

The source of cruisinginthewake.com, a static cruise-planning website with ship, port, restaurant and article pages, interactive tools (calculators, voyage-pack PWAs) and the admin scripts that build and validate them.

## How we got here

Every change entry, newest first: what it was for, and what it made possible.

### 20261028-change-record-in-inthewake

Task `change-record-deploy-repos-20261028`.

**Why.** InTheWake had no record of why its code changes: a commit message keeps what changed, not why it mattered, and the reason lived only in the memory of whoever made it. Ken asked on 2026-10-27 for the household change record in every repository, tuned to each.

**Enables.** Every commit here that changes the admin scripts, the validators, the site's scripts and styles and its hub pages now carries why it mattered and what it enables, judged when it is made, while changes to the ship, port, restaurant and article pages, the images and the files the build writes alone need no entry.

**Untested:** This commit installs the gate here; the engine and this repository's tuning are tested in Project-Sophos, in admin/tests/change-record.test.mjs and admin/tests/change-record-deploy.test.mjs.
